scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Depends on: Phase 0 deploy, trace and outbox path proven in prod."
scores.rationale: Phases go tenancy/ledger → catalog → subscriptions → invoicing → payments → usage → surfaces, each with explicit dependencies and exit checks.

scores.evidence: One live-mode $1.00 charge and its refund complete in prod. A single trace covers every tier
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production path through edge, API, DB, outbox, worker, PSP, webhook and back, before any features.

scores.evidence: Never flip the ledger to AP. If one primary can't keep up with ledger writes (sustained >~3k postings/s or primary CPU >70% at peak), shard by tenant
scores.rationale: Irreversible and major decisions are listed up front with defaults and concrete flip conditions, and the interpretation assumption is stated.

scores.evidence: Public API shape... This has the widest blast radius because tenants code against it.
scores.rationale: Phases explicitly order widest-impact items first (RLS, ledger, API contract, ingestion contract) and leaf items like PDF rendering last.

scores.evidence: RLS on every table, app role without BYPASSRLS, scoped API keys, append-only audit log.
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security treatment in every phase from Phase 0 onward.

scores.evidence: End-to-end OpenTelemetry trace, structured logs with tenant and request IDs, API rate/error/duration metrics, alerts on outbox lag and webhook failures.
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every later phase with specific metrics.

scores.evidence: Terraform for all infra, image pinned by digest, dependency lockfiles, versioned migrations.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely in every phase (fixed seeds, test clocks, golden files, replayable raw events, DR rebuild).

scores.evidence: PITR on and one restore tested. PSP calls happen outside the DB transaction (via the outbox). Webhooks return 2xx only after a durable write.
scores.rationale: Failure handling is concrete in every phase from Phase 0, including idempotency, circuit breakers, DLQs and fault injection.

scores.evidence: N/A. There is no AI or agentic component.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Multi-currency FX conversion and settlement. Pull forward when a tenant needs to invoice in one currency and settle in another.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with concrete pull-forward conditions.

note: Very strong plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content; no material gaps found.
